svg.title: The causal attention mask as a 6 by 6 grid
svg.desc: Rows are query positions and columns are key positions for the sentence "The cat sat on the mat". Cells on or below the diagonal are filled, marking the positions a query is allowed to read. Cells above the diagonal are empty and are set to minus infinity before the softmax, so position 1 may read only itself while position 6 may read all six. Every row is normalised to sum to one after the softmax.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Causal mask: what each query position is allowed to read

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The mask is added to the scores before the softmax, which is why it is minus infinity and not zero.
